notes.title: Have you played Consternation II yet?
notes.content:
[b]"ONE OF THE BEST INDIE HORROR GAMES"[/b]. [url=https://gamejolt.com/games/consternation2/359719] Consternation II [/url]is a free to play indie horror game developed by CrackedGhostGames. Can you escape the factory? 

[b]What Gamers are Saying[/b]

- [i]"That made me freeze up inside, and that's never happened in my entire life."[/i]

- [i]"This is nightmarish"[/i]

- [i]"Definition of a scary game... Consternation II"[/i]

notes.title: Pembrey is completed!
notes.content: Thank you all for supporting the game throughout it's journey! The game is now 100% complete and from now on, will only be updated for bug fixes and such. Enjoy the game everyone!

notes.title: Game is Going to be Delayed
notes.content: Due to a massive amount of schoolwork I have to delay this game for another month or so. I have 15 days left of school and a ton of work to do and if it's not done, I won't graduate. I'm still working on the game during the week but only about 3 hours per week. I'm going to make the most use I can of my weekends to work on the game. Plus if I really wanted to, I could rush this game out the door but the ending would be really bad and rushed so I'd rather take my time on it. I hope you all can understand.

notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
This update adds...
[list]
    [*]Rebindable Keys
    [*]New Credits Screen
    [*]Major Optimization for "Low-End" Devices
    [*]New Menu Options
    [*]Grammatical Fixes
[/list]
Hope you enjoy! I still plan on releasing the game in it's entirety as of May 2018. I'll keep you guys updated!

notes.title: Patch Tonight.
notes.content:
As per usual, fixing bugs always seems to create more bugs. I've been doing some work fixing them over this week and I'm going to release it tonight. This patch includes:
[list]
    [*]Fixed the bug where the mac version won't start.
    [*]Fixed the "half my screen is black" bug.
    [*]Fixed some scenes having a flashlight where you shouldn't.
    [*]Made some sounds quieter to avoid ear-piercing screeches.
    [*]Added an extras screen after you beat the current build.
    [*]Added some visual goodies.
[/list]

notes.title: NO UPDATES UNTIL COMPLETION
notes.content: In order to make it so none of you players have to restart the game every time a new build comes out, I've decided to update the game once it's completed. The game is predicted to be completed in early 2018 so stay tuned. If you want to keep up on the development process you can [url=http://www.crackedghostgames.com/devlogs]click right here[/url] to be redirected to my devlogs on my website. Cheers!
